```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(jsonlite)

# Resolves data-file paths relative to the repository root, never to R's own current
# working directory (which Quarto may point at the document's folder, not the caller's
# shell location): primarily the LL_REPO_ROOT env var render_reports.py always sets
# (D-04/Task 3), with a defensive fallback via knitr::current_input() for standalone
# `quarto render` invocations (e.g. an IDE's own Render button) where LL_REPO_ROOT is
# not set. No working-directory query or mutation of any kind appears in this document.
resolve_repo_root <- function() {
  env_root <- Sys.getenv("LL_REPO_ROOT", unset = "")
  if (nzchar(env_root)) {
    return(normalizePath(env_root, mustWork = TRUE))
  }

  doc_path <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
  if (is.null(doc_path) || !nzchar(doc_path)) {
    stop(
      "Could not resolve the repository root: LL_REPO_ROOT is unset and ",
      "knitr::current_input() returned no document path. Set LL_REPO_ROOT explicitly ",
      "(render_reports.py always sets this for real renders)."
    )
  }
  # template.qmd lives at <repo_root>/data-pipeline/R/report/template.qmd
  candidate <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(doc_path), "..", "..", ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  marker <- file.path(candidate, "CLAUDE.md")
  if (!file.exists(marker)) {
    stop(
      "Could not resolve the repository root from the document path (", doc_path, "). ",
      "Set LL_REPO_ROOT explicitly."
    )
  }
  candidate
}

repo_root <- resolve_repo_root()

# D-06/A4: read the already-published, already-merged runtime artifacts -- the same files
# the web app itself reads -- never data/ll_content.json (human-owned source) directly.
ll_metadata <- fromJSON(
  file.path(repo_root, "app", "public", "data", "ll_metadata.json"),
  simplifyVector = TRUE
)
report_tokens <- fromJSON(
  file.path(repo_root, "data", "report_tokens.json"),
  simplifyVector = TRUE
)

slug <- params$slug
lang <- params$lang

if (!slug %in% names(ll_metadata)) {
  stop(
    "Unknown Living Lab slug '", slug, "'. Known slugs: ",
    paste(names(ll_metadata), collapse = ", ")
  )
}
if (!lang %in% c("en", "de")) {
  stop("Unknown language '", lang, "'. Expected 'en' or 'de'.")
}

ll <- ll_metadata[[slug]]
ll_lang <- ll[[lang]]
strings <- report_tokens$strings[[lang]]$report

ll_name <- ll_lang$name
ll_tagline <- ll_lang$tagline
ll_region <- ll$region[[lang]]
ll_nuts3 <- ll$nuts3
```
